collections.title: Intro
What is Art Therapy
collections.mainContent:
What is art therapy?

Art therapy is the use of various forms of creative expression and play, that when explored within the therapeutic relationship offer significant personal insights. These lead to improved mental, emotional and physical wellbeing.

collections.title: What can it help with
collections.mainContent:
What can it help you with?

Recovery from trauma 

Anxiety symptoms

Depression symptoms

Relationship challenges

Feelings of isolation

Difficult or persistent emotions

Blocked creativity

Understanding dreams

Aches, pains and discomfort in the body

Identity questions

 

Art therapy supports and develops

Feeling better organised

Patience with yourself and others

Better communication

Empathy for others

Collaboration with others

Compliments other mental health and wellbeing treatments

Feeling motivated

Self awareness

Understanding emotional triggers

Dealing with stress

A sense of connection to
self and others

collections.title: What I offer
collections.mainContent:
What Anna offers

Anna offers personalised individual sessions on a one-off or ongoing basis. These sessions provide the opportunity for you to unwind and creatively explore your lived experience with Anna over the course of one hour.
